name: @teactjs/ui
description: Telegram UI components for Teact — Message, Button, InlineKeyboard, Photo, and more

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target bun --external @teactjs/renderer --external @teactjs/react --external @teactjs/runtime --external @teactjs/telegram --external @teactjs/storage && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json
